text:
Large caps fell on Friday while smallcaps gained.

• Sensex closed at 83,339.26, down 989.34 points (1.17%); Nifty 50 closed at 25,607.20, down 277.30 points (1.07%), per Business Today and Kotak Neo closing reports.
• Nifty Smallcap 100 rose 0.56% and Nifty Midcap 100 rose 0.10%, per the same reports.
• HCL Technologies, Infosys and TCS were among the largest losers on the Nifty, per Kotak Neo and Business Today.
• Both reports cited crude oil concerns and profit booking, with IT and banking heavyweights under pressure.

Our view: when benchmarks fall while the broader market holds up, the headline index can overstate or understate what a diversified portfolio experienced that day. One session is a thin sample, so we read this as dispersion rather than a trend. This is an interpretation, not a prediction or advice.

For practitioners: on days when index heavyweights and the broader market move in opposite directions, how do you frame the day for clients?
